title: Riot Squad Punx Strawberry, Raspberry & Blueberry Nicsalt E-Liquid 10ml
description: All the berries, all the time. Such is the clarion call of fruity vape lovers that Riot Squad have answered them with this irresistible medley of our favourite summer berries. Tart raspberry, luscious strawberry and rich, tangy blueberry collide in a dreamy fruit vape for all seasons. Riot Squad’s Punx Nicotine Salt e-liquids are formulated with hybrid nicotine, an innovative blend of freebase nicotine and nicotine salts. The combination of the freebase and salt nicotine, and,50/50 PG and VG ratio, provides the perfect balance of flavour and throat hit and makes this eliquid ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape kit devices.
